mega.intro: Eight programmes across technology, digital arts and specialized languages.

hero.subtitle: Kennedy Academy is a technology, digital arts and languages academy in El Biar — with a robotics lab, a media studio and a cafe that stay open between sessions.

hub.title: A school that stays open.
hub.intro: Between sessions, the campus becomes a workshop — a robotics lab, a media studio and a cafe where the work continues.

robotics-lab.name: Robotics Lab
robotics-lab.blurb: A hardware bench for prototypes, sensors and competition builds.
robotics-lab.alt: A maker workbench with electronics, tools and a robotics prototype.

media-studio.name: Media Studio
media-studio.blurb: Camera, light and sound — where stories are planned, shot and cut.
media-studio.alt: A camera and lighting setup inside a small media studio.

cafe-coworking.name: Cafe & Coworking
cafe-coworking.blurb: The room between classes: espresso, long tables and unfinished ideas.
cafe-coworking.alt: Warm cafe tables and chairs arranged for coworking.

courses.title: The Course Matrix
courses.intro: Filter by discipline and age, then open a programme to see the modules and join the waitlist.

detail.admissionsIntro: Request the full syllabus and we will confirm your placement.
detail.whatsappPrefill: Hello Kennedy Academy — I would like to know more about {course}.

robotics-kids.title: Robotics for Kids
robotics-kids.description: Introductory robotics where children build, wire, and programme their first moving machines through playful, project-based sessions.
robotics-kids.lede: First machines, first circuits, first moment of "we built that".
outcomes: Assemble and wire a working robot from a guided kit.
Explain what a sensor does and use one in a small project.
Debug a simple programme with a mentor's guidance.
Present a finished build to the group.

modules.title: How machines move
modules.description: Motors, wheels and structure: the mechanics behind a first robot.

modules.title: Circuits and safety
modules.description: Power, switches and sensors, wired safely on a breadboard.

modules.title: First programme
modules.description: Sequences, loops and timing that make the robot move on purpose.

modules.title: Sensor logic
modules.description: Read a distance sensor and turn its signal into a decision.

modules.title: Team build
modules.description: Design, assemble and test a shared robot against a simple brief.

modules.title: Demo day
modules.description: Present the build, explain how it works and refine one weakness.

capstone.title: A line-following robot
capstone.description: Students deliver a working robot that follows a marked course, documented with a simple build journal and demonstrated on demo day.

robotics-juniors.title: Robotics for Juniors
robotics-juniors.description: Advanced robotics for teenagers — sensor integration, team challenges, and competition-ready engineering projects.
robotics-juniors.lede: Engineering with constraints: sensors, competition rules and a team that ships.
outcomes: Design a robot around a defined challenge and rule set.
Integrate multiple sensors and explain the signal flow.
Work in a team with clear build, test and review roles.
Document and pitch an engineering decision.

modules.title: Challenge brief
modules.description: Constraints, scoring and strategy: what winning actually requires.

modules.title: Mechanical design
modules.description: Chassis, gearing and torque decisions made against the rule set.

modules.title: Sensor integration
modules.description: Combine distance, line and touch sensors and trace the signal flow.

modules.title: Control logic
modules.description: State machines and calibration for repeatable autonomous runs.

modules.title: Competition build
modules.description: Iterate the build under time pressure, with test data driving changes.

modules.title: Final run
modules.description: Run the challenge, present the engineering log and review the result.

capstone.title: A competition-ready robot
capstone.description: A rule-compliant robot, an engineering log and a short design defence presented to mentors and families.

ai-fluency.title: AI Fluency
ai-fluency.description: Age-appropriate AI literacy covering prompts, creative tools, responsible use, and real-world applications students can explain with confidence.
ai-fluency.lede: Understand the tools shaping the next decade — and use them with judgement.
outcomes: Explain how large language models generate and miss information.
Write effective prompts for a defined creative or study task.
Identify bias, hallucination and privacy risks in AI output.
Build a small project that uses AI responsibly.

modules.title: How AI works
modules.description: Patterns, predictions and the limits that explain confident mistakes.

modules.title: Prompt craft
modules.description: Context, constraints and iteration: writing prompts that can be checked.

modules.title: Creative studio
modules.description: Image, text and sound tools explored through a small creative brief.

modules.title: Responsible use
modules.description: Bias, privacy and attribution — the questions to ask before publishing.

modules.title: Study and work
modules.description: Use AI as a thinking partner without outsourcing the thinking.

modules.title: Project clinic
modules.description: Build, critique and present a small project that uses AI deliberately.

capstone.title: An AI-assisted project
capstone.description: A small researched or creative project with a written account of every AI tool used, its output and its limits.

python-programming.title: Python Programming
python-programming.description: Structured Python foundations from variables and logic to small apps and data projects, taught with patience and practical examples.
python-programming.lede: From first variables to a small application — logic you can carry into any field.
outcomes: Write readable Python using variables, conditionals and loops.
Break a problem into functions and test each piece.
Work with lists, dictionaries and simple files.
Ship a small command-line project.

modules.title: Variables, types and input
modules.description: Store values, read input and print results with clear, readable code.

modules.title: Conditionals and loops
modules.description: Make decisions and repeat work without repeating yourself.

modules.title: Functions and clean structure
modules.description: Break a problem into named functions and test each piece.

modules.title: Collections
modules.description: Lists and dictionaries for organising real data.

modules.title: Files and small data projects
modules.description: Read and write files, then shape the data into a small report.

modules.title: Project week
modules.description: Build, debug and present a command-line project from an empty file.

capstone.title: A command-line application
capstone.description: A working command-line tool with a README, a short test list and a live walkthrough.

technical-english.title: Technical English
technical-english.description: English for engineering and digital work — describing systems, writing clear documentation, and presenting technical decisions with confidence.
technical-english.lede: The English you need to explain a build, write a spec and hold your ground in a technical conversation.
outcomes: Describe a system, process or prototype in precise spoken English.
Write short technical documentation with a clear structure.
Present a project and answer questions without reading from a script.
Use technical vocabulary accurately in everyday professional contexts.

modules.title: Technical register
modules.description: Choosing precise verbs, quantities and qualifiers for engineering work.

modules.title: Describing systems
modules.description: Explain how a system is built and what limits its performance.

modules.title: Documentation
modules.description: Write short specs, READMEs and instructions a stranger could follow.

modules.title: Presenting a build
modules.description: Shape a five-minute technical presentation and rehearse difficult questions.

modules.title: Meetings and collaboration
modules.description: Clarify, disagree and negotiate scope in professional English.

modules.title: Portfolio clinic
modules.description: Review the written and spoken work produced across the programme.

capstone.title: A technical presentation and written brief
capstone.description: A five-minute presentation and a one-page technical brief, delivered in front of the cohort.

german-mobility.title: German for Academic & Tech Mobility
german-mobility.description: German for students planning to study or work in Germany — academic vocabulary, application documents, and the confidence to handle daily bureaucracy.
german-mobility.lede: German for the next step: a place at university, an internship or a technical role in a German-speaking country.
outcomes: Handle everyday and academic situations in German with growing confidence.
Read and complete common application and enrolment documents.
Introduce yourself and your technical background in an interview.
Follow the structure of a German-language technical presentation.

modules.title: Starter German
modules.description: Pronunciation, sentence structure and the phrases that carry a first week.

modules.title: Academic vocabulary
modules.description: The words and routines of a German university.

modules.title: Applications
modules.description: Read, complete and explain the documents a move requires.

modules.title: Technical German
modules.description: Introduce your discipline, project and experience in plain German.

modules.title: Interviews and presentations
modules.description: Rehearse an interview and a short technical presentation.

modules.title: Arrival clinic
modules.description: Registration, housing and the practical conversations that follow admission.

capstone.title: A study-mobility dossier
capstone.description: A German-language CV, motivation letter and oral presentation, reviewed against a real application checklist.

audiovisual-training.title: Audiovisual Training
audiovisual-training.description: Film, sound, and visual storytelling — students learn to plan, shoot, and edit content with professional creative discipline.
audiovisual-training.lede: Plan it, shoot it, cut it — visual storytelling with professional discipline.
outcomes: Plan a short film from treatment to shot list.
Operate a camera and capture clean audio.
Edit a sequence with rhythm and continuity.
Screen and critique a finished piece.

modules.title: Story and treatment
modules.description: Turn an idea into a treatment with a clear point of view.

modules.title: Pre-production
modules.description: Shot lists, locations and roles planned before anyone presses record.

modules.title: Camera
modules.description: Framing, movement and exposure decisions that serve the story.

modules.title: Sound
modules.description: Microphones, levels and room tone — capturing audio that can be edited.

modules.title: Editing
modules.description: Assembly, rhythm and colour in a first cut that holds attention.

modules.title: Screening
modules.description: Screen the work, take structured critique and deliver a final cut.

capstone.title: A short film
capstone.description: A three-to-five-minute film, delivered with a treatment, shot list and a finished edit screened to the cohort.

multimedia.title: Multimedia
multimedia.description: Digital design and multimedia production — graphics, layout, and portfolio-ready creative work for the modern creative economy.
multimedia.lede: Design systems, layouts and digital assets that hold up in a real portfolio.
outcomes: Apply layout, type and colour principles to a digital piece.
Build a small multi-page project with a consistent system.
Prepare assets for screen and social formats.
Present a portfolio-ready case study.

modules.title: Design foundations
modules.description: Grid, type and hierarchy as decisions, not decoration.

modules.title: Colour and image
modules.description: Build a small visual system with colour, imagery and rules.

modules.title: Layout studio
modules.description: Compose pages with deliberate space, rhythm and reading order.

modules.title: Digital production
modules.description: Prepare assets for screen, print and social without losing quality.

modules.title: Portfolio craft
modules.description: Select and sequence work so the strongest idea lands first.

modules.title: Final review
modules.description: Present a case study, take critique and refine the final piece.

capstone.title: A portfolio case study
capstone.description: A multi-page case study documenting the brief, process and final work, ready to share with a client or school.

method.title: Engineering rigour, open culture.
method.intro: Three commitments shape every programme, every cohort and every room.

rigorous-engineering.title: Rigorous Engineering
rigorous-engineering.body: We teach the reasoning behind the build — structure, constraints, testing, and the discipline to ship something that works.

open-lab-culture.title: Open Lab Culture
open-lab-culture.body: The lab stays open beyond class hours. Students prototype, break things, and learn to ask better questions alongside mentors.

bilingual-fluency.title: Bilingual Fluency
bilingual-fluency.body: Technical English and French are practised inside the work, not bolted on — so students can explain, pitch and collaborate.

testimonials.title: What families say
testimonials.intro: Parents across Algiers trust Kennedy Academy for structured, inspiring education.

nadia.quote: My daughter went from being shy with technology to presenting her robot project with confidence. The campus feels welcoming and serious at the same time.
nadia.name: Nadia B.

karim.quote: The Python programme gave my son a real foundation — not just games, but logic he uses in school now. The instructors are patient and clearly know their subject.
karim.name: Karim M.

sofia.quote: We enrolled in the English and French levels programme. The progression is clear, and our daughter actually looks forward to her sessions every week.
sofia.name: Sofia L.

yasmine.quote: The multimedia course opened a creative path we hadn't considered. Professional atmosphere, warm teachers, and a campus that feels open and modern.
yasmine.name: Yasmine K.
